description: Actual third output has a full-length plum-purple Imperial outer tunic/robe over a cream undertunic, with richly woven gold borders, broad sleeve cuffs, a round shoulder clasp and a decorated belt. A purple mantle drapes down one side. Both hands and dark gold-trimmed boots are visible. The figure stands upright against plain bare stone columns and doorway; no wall banner, emblem, words, armor or weapon is visible.
